events.title: Comet 69P/Taylor passes perihelion
events.difficulty_alt: This event is visible through a large telescope from Jakarta.
events.peak_event_time: Thu, 12 Nov 20265 days ago
events.visibility_summary: From Jakartaon the day of perihelion it will be visible in the morning sky, becoming accessible around 23:38, when it reaches an altitude of 21° above your eastern horizon. It will then reach its highest point in the sky at 04:01, 70° above your northern horizon. It will be lost to dawn twilight around 04:33, 69° above your north-western horizon.
events.description:
Comet 69P/Taylor will make its closest approach to the Sun on
    12 November, at a distance of
     2.27AU.
